2) Locate invoice date:
- "Rechnungsdatum 30.09.2023" → Invoice.Date = "30.09.2023".

- "Unsere USt-Id." corresponds to the issuer (Aptean Austria GmbH) → Sender.VatId = "ATU75601939".

- Line showing totals: "4.003,00 EUR" (net sum of work + km) and "Mehrwertsteuer (20,00 %) 800,60 EUR" and final "4.803,60 EUR".
- Interpret German number formatting (periods not used; comma as decimal separator):

  - Vat.Rate = 20,00 % → 20
  - Vat.Amount = 800,60 → 800.60
  - GrandTotal.Amount = 4.803,60 → 4803.60

5) Verify no additional VAT groups or exchange rates:
- Only one VAT group (20%) applies to entire invoice; no exchange rate applicable.

6) Ensure no guessing:
- All extracted values are explicitly present in text; if any were missing, they'd be left empty.
